name: LA Port Container Throughput
citation: Port of Los Angeles / City of Los Angeles. "Port of Los Angeles - TEU Counts Monthly and Calendar YTD." data.lacity.org, 2020. Covariate: U.S. Census Bureau, "Advance Retail Sales: Retail and Food Services (RSAFS)," retrieved from FRED, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis.
license: Public domain (City of Los Angeles open data; U.S. Census Bureau / FRED public-domain series).
description:
Monthly total container throughput in twenty-foot equivalent units (TEU) at the Port of Los Angeles, 2009-01 to 2016-09, with U.S. advance retail sales as a leading external covariate. Strong annual peak-season seasonality. Application: port/terminal capacity and drayage planning.

Covariate glossary:
- container throughput teu: total monthly container throughput at the Port of Los Angeles, twenty-foot equivalent units per month (target).
- retail sales: U.S. advance retail & food-services sales, seasonally adjusted, USD millions (FRED RSAFS); a leading indicator of import container demand.
preprocessing: 1. Loaded monthly Total TEUs from data.lacity.org (93 rows, 2009-01..2016-09).
2. Reindexed to a complete monthly grid; linearly interpolated the few missing 2016 months.
3. Joined U.S. advance retail sales (FRED RSAFS) on year-month as an external leading covariate.
4. Removed month-of-year Fourier helper columns; single shared time index only.
